description: This PHP class defines a script for managing AWS SDK services within a Composer-based PHP project. It includes functionality to remove unused AWS service directories based on project configuration and environment context, with methods for building service mappings, verifying service listings, and deleting directories with retry logic.

classes.name: Composer
classes.description: Defines static methods for managing AWS SDK services related to Composer scripts, including removing unused services and building service mappings.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesInDev
methods.description: Removes unused AWS SDK services in a development environment based on Event and optional Filesystem instances.

methods.name: removeUnusedServices
methods.description: Removes unused AWS SDK services based on Event and optional Filesystem instances, intended for production or non-dev environments.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesWithConfig
methods.description: Core method that performs the removal process based on environment mode and project configuration.

methods.name: buildServiceMapping
methods.description: Builds a mapping of AWS service namespaces to service names using a JSON manifest.

methods.name: verifyListedServices
methods.description: Checks if listed services are valid according to the built service mapping.

methods.name: removeServiceDirs
methods.description: Deletes directories of AWS services that are not in the listed services or marked as unsafe for deletion, with retry logic for filesystem operations.
